plugin.note: Use melee against Ket or melee-using Xil in Mor Ul Rek, safespotting through vents where possible. Inner-area level 221 Ket can be stacked and bursted or barraged after showing a fire cape.

requirements: Hot Stuff unlock purchased for 100 slayer points before TzHaar can be assigned.
No Slayer level, quest, or combat requirement for the regular city assignment.
Show a fire cape once to access the inner level 221 TzHaar-Ket area.
Use the Jad or Zuk alternatives only when the Slayer master offers them and the player is prepared for the full minigame run.
mechanics: TzHaar-Hur and TzHaar-Ket primarily use melee.
TzHaar-Xil can appear as melee variants or a melee/ranged ring-disc variant.
TzHaar-Mej uses magic and melee and can call nearby Xil and Ket for help.
Attacking Hur can aggro nearby TzHaar, including Mej, Xil, and Ket.
TzHaar-Ket and melee-using Xil can be safespotted through vents in the city.
The level 221 TzHaar-Ket in the inner area has low Magic and no magic defence bonus, making burst and barrage methods practical.
Protect from Melee prevents all damage in the inner Ket area when Ket heavily outnumber nearby Mej and Xil.
Ring of wealth improves gem-related drop chances and affects eligible level 221 Ket drops.

methods.label: Requirements and unlock
methods.summary: Purchase Hot Stuff before planning TzHaar tasks, then choose regular city kills, Jad, or Zuk based on the Slayer master's offer.
requiredOrKeyItems: Teleport to Mor Ul Rek or Karamja volcano
steps: Confirm Hot Stuff is unlocked; it costs 100 slayer points and enables Chaeldar, Nieve/Steve, and Duradel/Kuradal assignments.
Use a Slayer helmet or black mask bonus for normal city kills.
Bring a Ring of wealth if prioritising gem drops or eligible level 221 Ket bolt-tip drops.
Enter Mor Ul Rek and choose Ket or melee-using Xil for straightforward task progress.
notes: The regular city task has no Slayer level, quest, or combat requirement beyond receiving the task.

methods.label: Ket and melee Xil safespots
methods.summary: Kill TzHaar-Ket or melee-using TzHaar-Xil, using vents to safespot melee pressure where convenient.
recommendedFor: players avoiding Mej magic or Xil ranged variants
prayers: Protect from Melee when tanking Ket directly
Offensive melee prayers for faster kills
steps: Target TzHaar-Ket or the melee-only TzHaar-Xil variants.
Use nearby vents to block melee pathing and reduce supply usage.
Avoid the ring/disc TzHaar-Xil variant if you want a simpler melee-only target.
Keep distance from Mej groups unless prepared to handle magic attacks and help calls.
risks: The ranged Xil variant can attack from distance and is less suited to the basic vent safespot path.
Moving through dense city packs can chain extra aggression.

methods.label: Inner Ket burst or barrage
methods.summary: After showing a fire cape, group level 221 Ket around TzHaar-Ket-Rak's Challenges and use burst or barrage spells under Protect from Melee.
requiredOrKeyItems: Fast ranged weapon such as darts or knives
steps: Show a fire cape once to unlock the inner area.
Move to the TzHaar-Ket-Rak's Challenges area where level 221 Ket are concentrated.
Use cheap darts, knives, goading potion, or Dinh's bulwark special attack to gather the Ket.
Keep Protect from Melee active because the grouped monsters are primarily Ket.
Cast burst or barrage spells once the Ket are stacked.
Avoid pulling nearby Xil if using wide aggro tools.
risks: Aggroing nearby Xil can add ranged damage and disrupt the low-damage setup.
This method requires inner-area access and uses more runes than melee safespots.

methods.label: Hur and Mej aggro management
methods.summary: Avoid casual Hur and Mej pulls unless deliberately managing nearby helper aggression.
recommendedFor: players trying to avoid extra damage
steps: Do not start on Hur if nearby Mej, Xil, or Ket would make the area messy.
Treat Mej as a higher-risk target because attacking one near higher TzHaar can call Xil and Ket.
If extra monsters aggro, reposition through vents or move to a cleaner Ket/Xil area.
risks: Hur aggression can bring several nearby TzHaar into combat.
Mej magic damage and help calls make it less desirable for straightforward melee tasks.

methods.label: Jad and Zuk alternatives
methods.summary: When offered by the Slayer master, regular TzHaar can be replaced by TzTok-Jad or TzKal-Zuk for a full Fight Cave or Inferno task.
recommendedFor: players seeking fire cape, infernal cape, or pet-rate bonuses
players prepared for a full minigame run
steps: Accept the Jad alternative only when prepared to complete a Fight Cave run.
Expect 37,010 total Slayer XP for a successful Jad task.
Accept the Zuk alternative only after at least one previous off-task Zuk kill.
Expect about 125,000 total Slayer XP for a successful Inferno task.
Use the dedicated TzTok-Jad or TzKal-Zuk strategy records for combat mechanics.
notes: Jad receives a 50% pet-rate improvement on task.
Zuk receives a 25% pet-rate improvement on task.

styleOptions.label: Melee city safespot
styleOptions.summary: Use a melee setup against Ket or melee Xil, using vents to block melee pathing.
notes: Best default option for ordinary TzHaar tasks because it avoids the complexity of Mej and ranged Xil.

styleOptions.label: Magic Ket burst or barrage
styleOptions.summary: Burst or barrage grouped level 221 Ket in the inner area after unlocking fire cape access.
notes: Use Protect from Melee and avoid pulling Xil into the stack.
